"On Google TV sets, Wi-Fi networks saved during initial setup belong to com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith. Disabling setupwraith so the stock Google TV launcher stays dead will delete a Wi-Fi network owned by setupwraith.

Before disabling setupwraith:
1. Open Wi-Fi Settings → select your Wi-Fi network → Forget network.
2. Re-connect to your Wi-Fi network (it will now belong to com.android.tv.settings).
3. Return here and tap "I Forgot & Re-added Wi-Fi — Continue"."

"Keep Alive monitors the Accessibility Service and automatically restores it if your TV turns it off.\n\n✓ Because WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is granted on this TV, Keep Alive repairs Accessibility directly in-process without needing Network ADB (port 5555) to stay open."

"⚠️ Security Warning:

Keep Alive monitors and restores permissions if your TV turns them off in the background.

Without WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, Keep Alive requires Network Debugging (ADB on port 5555) to stay enabled on your home network. For better security, run Pair / Repair ADB in Secure Mode first so WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is granted and port 5555 can be closed.

Enable Keep Alive anyway?"
